point_identity.continuum_integrals: R781 frozen initial physical integrals and selected branch parameters; both the material dictionary geometry and all endpoint companion quadratures use order 20 on all levels, while base and target use the recorded working order. Final field uses order 20 throughout.
point_identity.fixed_metric: One fixed R781 initial circular three-lobe closed shell, metric dx^2+[(.45-Z0)/.45]^2 de^2 centrally, with its complete two rolls, two filled disk atlases and exact rim identifications. No R772/R776 metric is used. Initial diameter and required radius at every phase come from the R781 phase-zero formula.
point_identity.temporal_basis: CubicSpline natural left, zero right derivative at pi/2; zero coefficient at t0
point_identity.world_motion: R781 actual left extremal plane minus .008sin(t); the selected physical grip is either both complete heads, the whole left head plus the right central disk, or the right central disk alone. Right-cap plane bend is part of the actual field.
